title: A Hymn for the Bell
author: Mara Thackeray
blurb: Zephyrine Lockridge, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
